verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API with access tokens and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so it can be driven headlessly. It also offers deploy-notification tracking, which is commonly called from release pipelines, and mentions a Terraform provider for automating project setup. However, the evidence never shows explicit CI integration or a dedicated headless CLI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI integrations (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline steps for deploy and source-map upload), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
